2608.11260.title: Glance, Scrutinize, and Think: Advancing Video Anomaly Detection from Training-Free to Agentic Reasoning
2608.11260.paper_summary: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) aims to identify anomalous events and localize their temporal intervals. Existing approaches exhibit a "when-what" dissociation: traditional DNN-based methods localize when anomalies occur but lack semantic understanding, whereas LLM-based methods explain what happens but neglect precise temporal grounding. We attribute this to the absence of a unified reasoning paradigm. Inspired by how humans inspect surveillance videos - glancing globally to form temporal hypotheses, scrutinizing suspicious segments, and thinking iteratively to correct errors - we study this global-to-local paradigm from two perspectives. We first propose Glance then Scrutinize (GtS), a training-free framework using static and dynamic textual guidance for coarse-to-fine anomaly grounding and understanding, balancing accuracy and speed. To break the ceiling imposed by frozen external modules, we further propose a tool-augmented agentic VAD method, where a multimodal large language model learns to invoke a video cropping tool, inspect densely resampled frames, and self-correct mislocalized hypotheses, via cold-start supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with a joint answer-grounding reward. For training and evaluation, we extend our prior VAGU benchmark into VAGU-T (Video Anomaly Grounding, Understanding, and Thinking), comprising 7,567 real-world videos over 21 anomaly categories with human-validated grounding, explanations, QA pairs, and chain-of-thought tool-calling traces. We further introduce JeAUG, a metric jointly evaluating semantic interpretability and temporal precision. Experiments show that GtS substantially surpasses training-free baselines, while the agentic model delivers both higher accuracy and faster inference.
2608.11260.paper_summary_zh: 視頻異常檢測（VAD）旨在識別異常事件並定位其時間區間。現有的方法表現出「何時-什麼」的脫節：傳統的基於深度神經網絡（DNN）的方法能夠定位異常發生的時間，但缺乏語義理解，而基於大型語言模型（LLM）的方法則解釋了發生了什麼，但忽略了精確的時間定位。我們將此歸因於缺乏統一的推理範式。受到人類檢查監控視頻的啟發——全局瀏覽以形成時間假設，仔細檢查可疑片段，並反覆思考以糾正錯誤——我們從兩個角度研究這種全局到局部的範式。我們首先提出了「先瀏覽再仔細檢查」（GtS），這是一個無需訓練的框架，利用靜態和動態文本指導進行粗到細的異常定位和理解，平衡準確性和速度。為了打破由凍結的外部模塊所施加的上限，我們進一步提出了一種工具增強的主動VAD方法，其中一個多模態大型語言模型學會調用視頻裁剪工具，檢查密集重採樣的幀，並通過冷啟動的監督微調隨後進行強化學習，利用聯合答案定位獎勵來自我糾正錯位的假設。為了訓練和評估，我們將之前的VAGU基準擴展為VAGU-T（視頻異常定位、理解和思考），包括7,567個真實世界視頻，涵蓋21個異常類別，並具有經人類驗證的定位、解釋、問答對和思考鏈工具調用痕跡。我們還引入了JeAUG，一種共同評估語義可解釋性和時間精確度的指標。實驗表明，GtS顯著超越了無需訓練的基準，而主動模型則提供了更高的準確性和更快的推理速度。
